verdict.rationale: Temporal documents a first-party integration with the OpenAI Agents SDK for Python. It runs agents as Workflows and executes model calls as Activities, so they retry durably and survive Worker restarts without hand-written glue. Beyond that one integration, the evidence shows only cookbook recipes (Claude tool calling, the OpenAI API library), which are code examples the developer writes rather than packaged integrations. Missing for 10: evidenced first-party integrations for other agent frameworks and AI SDKs, packaged model-provider integrations beyond the OpenAI Agents SDK, integrations in languages other than Python, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an agent builder, first-party integrations wrap my AI stack — AI SDKs, agent frameworks, model providers — so agent steps get durability without glue code

citations.quote: Temporal's integration with the OpenAI Agents SDK for Python lets you run agents as Temporal Workflows.
model calls are executed as Activities, so they retry durably and are not repeated during Workflow replay. Your agents survive Worker restarts and can run for extended periods without losing state.
